The core duality lies between data completeness and trustworthiness. The system must balance coverage expansion with legal and operational constraints. Failure occurs when coverage exceeds usable data limits, leading to legal exposure. Trust is encoded in UX layers that compress complex data narratives into 10-second comprehensions. The licensed pipeline ensures data integrity through contractual guarantees. These primitives form a dual lattice: one of coverage vs. trust, and another of legal compliance vs. data richness. Each primitive maps to a Bayesian belief update in GSI and a state transition in GSE, ensuring coherent reasoning across domains.
